structure_architect.allowed_output: one qualitative hypothesis plus exactly one structural mutation and its topology
structure_architect.forbidden_output: policy code, benchmark scores, trace contents, hardcoding, variants, or sampling

duel.independence: six arm pipelines receive no other pair artifact or result
duel.seal_rule: all six final policies and every model receipt sealed before first frozen evaluation

pair_rule.candidate_win: both arms valid and candidate score strictly greater than incumbent score
pair_rule.incumbent_win: both arms valid and incumbent score strictly greater than candidate score
pair_rule.tie: both arms valid and scores exactly equal
pair_rule.invalid_pair: either arm invalid or replay2 nondeterministic

required: all six arms valid and replay2 deterministic
candidate wins at least two of three pairs and strictly exceed incumbent pair wins
candidate median strictly exceeds incumbent median
promotion.candidate_representative: candidate artifact at the candidate median score; if multiple, lexicographically smallest artifact SHA256
promotion.failure_action: retain immutable R0 champion structure and policy

close_confirmation.trigger: absolute median gap <= 0.25 or any valid non-tied pair absolute gap <= 0.25
close_confirmation.action: frozen replay3 for all six sealed arms
close_confirmation.pass: every replay3 normalized result equals both corresponding replay2 normalized results
close_confirmation.effect: confirmation only; no regeneration or policy change
close_confirmation.rationale: The 0.25 absolute band was fixed before reveal as a conservative near-tie boundary for decisions that could reverse through evaluator or transcription drift while remaining materially indistinguishable.

tie_breaks.pair_scores: exact equality is a tie and never a candidate win
tie_breaks.representative: median score then lexicographically smallest artifact SHA256
tie_breaks.promotion: no topology tie-break can override the strict majority and strict median requirements

spend.token_accounting: input, cached input, output, reasoning output, total, and effective tokens
